nodes.label: PGD2
props: A member of the class of  prostaglandins D that is prosta-5,13-dien-1-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 9 and 15 and an oxo group at position 11 (the 5Z,9α,13E,15S- stereoisomer).

references.title: Exacerbation of Aging-Associated and Instability-Induced Murine Osteoarthritis With Deletion of D Prostanoid Receptor 1, a Prostaglandin D(2) Receptor.
references.note: mouse OA (ageing and DMM): DP1 deletion worsens OA, the DP1 agonist BW245C protects; cartilage and bone, no pain outcome

references.title: Inhibition of interleukin-1beta-induced matrix metalloproteinases 1 and 13 production in human osteoarthritic chondrocytes by prostaglandin D2.
references.note: human OA chondrocytes: PGD2 acts through DP1; places PGD2-DP1 signalling in human OA tissue, not in the spinal cord

references.title: Molecular cloning and characterization of the human prostanoid DP receptor.
references.note: cloned human DP receptor: selective high-affinity PGD2 binding

references.journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
references.title: Molecular basis for ligand recognition and receptor activation of the prostaglandin D2 receptor DP1.
references.note: cryo-EM of human DP1 with PGD2 bound

references.title: Different effects of spinally applied prostaglandin D2 on responses of dorsal horn neurons with knee input in normal rats and in rats with acute knee inflammation.
references.note: rat, acute knee inflammation (not OA): spinal PGD2 or a DP1 agonist reduces dorsal horn responses to stimulation of the inflamed knee, a DP1 antagonist raises them

references.title: Inhibition of nociceptin-induced allodynia in conscious mice by prostaglandin D2.
references.note: mouse, intrathecal: PGD2 and the DP agonist BW245C block nociceptin-evoked allodynia, reversed by the DP antagonist BW A868C (the block's inhibitory arm)

nodes.label: PTGDR
props: Receptor for prostaglandin D2 (PGD2). The activity of this receptor is mainly mediated by G(s) proteins that stimulate adenylate cyclase, resulting in an elevation of intracellular cAMP.
